_comment: The public site: every page the wiki sync makes from .minecraft/wiki/ (source_manifest: its files and link conversions) except the ones under 'exclude', whose links become plain text. 'sidebar' is the wiki-only navigation page, kept in site/. 'order' only orders pages the sidebar and 'nav_extra' do not place (under More). 'pack_server' and 'pack_paths' mirror the pack server's ICRAFT_PACK_PATHS: a pack file a page links as a download goes to <pack_server>raw/main/<path> when its path starts with one of them ('.minecraft/*' = a file directly in .minecraft/), and is copied into the build otherwise. The build fails on any mention of the repository in a page's text ('forbidden_phrases', after removing 'allowed_phrases'), and on any URL of it anywhere. Build: python site/build.py
